Specification: This module specifies the state space and transition relation for a sliding-block puzzle, specifically the Klotski puzzle on a 4 by 5 board. The single state variable is the set of occupied piece positions, with each piece represented as a set of board coordinates, and steps move one piece by exactly one position into available empty space. The specification defines the initial Klotski arrangement, a goal predicate stating that the target 2x2 piece is absent from the board when the goal condition holds, helper operators for neighborhood directions and legal piece movement, and a Next action that nondeterministically chooses an empty position and updates the board accordingly. There is no explicit fault model, fairness, or temporal theorem in this file; the spec is a state-transition model intended for exploration of reachable puzzle configurations.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE x \in S : P(x) /\ \A y \in S : P(y) => y = x
